verdict.rationale: Zapier documents a typed Node module/CLI SDK (Platform CLI, Node.js v22, OAuth handling) and explicitly positions agents/skills as consuming Zapier as a 'code-file interface' via npm/skill registries, plus a documented MCP server for agent access. However, there's no dedicated 'official SDK' branding beyond the CLI, no OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404s), and no independent/hands-on corroboration of AI-native developers building against these SDKs specifically. missing for 10: independent verification of the AI-native SDK workflow, a published OpenAPI/typed client spec, and community evidence of agents actually building against the SDK rather than just using MCP/no-code paths.
